name: constraint-negotiation
title: Constraint Negotiation
summary: When nothing satisfies the constraints, name the binding one and offer evidence-based alternatives that relax exactly one thing, on an explicit patient decision.
when_to_use: Candidate generation returned no_candidate_matched or no_slot_available
A result is reachable only by relaxing a constraint and the patient has not yet decided
A patient asks whether they could travel further, use another day, or try a different hospital
Two constraints conflict and one of them has to yield

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.description: Stated constraints, each classified hard or soft with a source and a recorded_at.

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.description: Search output including near misses, with constraint_fit and coordinate-derived distance_miles.

inputs.name: availability
inputs.description: Slots and a result_kind distinguishing 'no slots under these constraints' from 'no provider'.

inputs.name: mandatory_conditions
inputs.description: specialty_identified, approval_present, slot_valid and their blocking_reasons.

outputs.name: alternatives
outputs.description: Each relaxes exactly one constraint, priced as additional_distance_miles or estimated_delay_days and backed by evidence_ids.

outputs.name: constraint_change
outputs.description: Written only after an explicit patient decision, carrying decided_by and the presented_options.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: Reason code is no_candidate_matched, hard_constraint_unsatisfiable, no_slot_available or ok.

references.purpose: Field-by-field table of hard versus soft defaults and which AlternativeOption kind applies to each.
